COMPONENTS.description: APT repository components (e.g., main, contrib, non-free)

MIRROR.description: Base URL for APT mirror (e.g., http://deb.debian.org/debian)

FALLBACK_MIRROR.description: Fallback mirror used if local mirror is removed

GRMLREPOS.description: Enable Grml repositories (set to non-empty to enable)

BACKPORTREPOS.description: Enable backports repository (set to non-empty to enable)

UPGRADE_SYSTEM.description: Whether to run APT update + upgrade during install

RM_APTCACHE.description: Whether to clean apt cache after install

PACKAGES.description: Whether to install packages listed in /etc/debootstrap/packages

GRMLPACKAGES.description: Additional packages to install when PACKAGES=yes

EXTRAPACKAGES.description: Whether to install extra local .deb packages from /etc/debootstrap/extrapackages/

RECONFIGURE.description: Space-separated list of packages to reconfigure

NOPASSWORD.description: If non-empty, skip setting root password

ROOTPASSWORD.description: Pre-set root password (insecure, prefer interactive or --password)

TARGET_UUID.description: UUID of the root filesystem for fstab
